nodes.why_this_node_exists: Demonstrates mission-level mastery without filling narrative gaps.
nodes.player_prompt: Reconstruct the preparation in 4–7 factual sentences, including Luke's names, Mark's number, Mark/Luke sign, room description and one explicit unknown.
nodes.accepted_answer: A source-grounded synthesis including Luke naming Peter and John; Mark saying two unnamed disciples; Mark/Luke water-carrier sign; householder instruction; large furnished upper room; preparation completed as told; and at least one unknown personal name.
nodes.accepted_variants: Any semantically equivalent 4–7 sentence synthesis preserving provenance and unknown boundaries.
nodes.rejected_answers: Invented personal names; saying Mark/Matthew explicitly name Peter and John; unsupported water-carrier=householder identity.
nodes.rejection_reason: Final reconstruction may synthesize but may not exceed the defined corpus.
nodes.success_feedback: LN-01 завершено доказово: відомі деталі й невідомі межі збережено разом.
nodes.partial_feedback: Назвіть лише відсутню required proposition; не скидайте правильні речення.
nodes.failure_feedback: Розбийте відповідь на: хто → знак → будинок/кімната → завершення → що не сказано.

hints.H1: Restate the task goal without revealing the answer.
hints.H3: Narrow to the decisive verse or claim.
hints.H5: Check provenance and the likely overclaim.
hints.H7: Guided answer/model may be shown; mastery becomes guided.

nodes.mastery_mode: independent; H6/H7 or answer reveal records guided mastery
nodes.functional_nonvisual_equivalent: Keyboard-complete labelled linear text/control flow; feedback announces result, source, confidence/TX1, mastery effect and next action.

nodes.skill_target: distinguish semantic proposition from translation wording
nodes.player_prompt: Which parts of the water-carrier/householder proposition are essential, and which are translation-level wording differences?
nodes.accepted_answer: Essential: a male person carrying water is the identifying encounter in Mark/Luke and the disciples are directed to the responsible person of the house; vessel and householder nouns may vary by translation without changing the proposition.
nodes.accepted_variants: Translation-equivalent vocabulary preserving the same proposition.
nodes.rejected_answers: Treating one English/Ukrainian noun as the only correct wording.
nodes.rejection_reason: The node grades proposition identity, not one translation string.
nodes.success_feedback: Перекладна нейтральність збережена без втрати змісту.
nodes.partial_feedback: Відокремте предмет/роль від конкретного словникового вибору.
nodes.failure_feedback: Порівняйте proposition-level meaning rather than exact nouns.
